lore: Wat Rong Khun, a quartz-white temple crafted by artist Chalermchai Kositpipat. The Golden Triangle is at the northern edge.

Mueang Chiang Rai.note: Wat Rong Khun stands just south of the city.

Mae Sai.note: Thailand's northernmost town, with a busy border market facing Myanmar.

Chiang Saen.note: Where Thailand, Laos and Myanmar meet on the Mekong.

Mae Fa Luang.note: Oolong tea terraces at Doi Mae Salong, and Doi Tung.
